title: P2 pilot: certified recall ceiling of converted windowed decay-attention at declared W, law placement vs folklore (Qwen3-0.6B)
one_line: Convert Qwen3-0.6B-Base to windowed decay-attention (A1 declared W=1024 headline, A4 W=512 co-registered certification cell; A2/A3 folklore placement comparators) and test sealed recall-ceiling predictions computed from the sealed RULER-subset battery (salt 779038744) against observed recall after 500M-token conversion training on rented cloud GPUs.

substrate.arch: 28 layers, hidden 1024, 16Q/8KV heads (GQA g=2), head_dim 128 decoupled, QK-norm, RoPE theta 1e6, tied emb, vocab 151936, bf16

A1.d8_note: Declared W=1024, n_full=0. NO inversion; target_recall NOT USED; law_provision() NOT called. W=512 rejected (bit-identical to A4); W=2048 rejected (vacuous KILL at seqlen 2048 + training cost + decay half-lives); telemetry inversion declined on merits (signature 4 not overridden).

A2.prediction: none (full-attn layers => no in-window bound); descriptive

A5.degenerate_reason: D2 pre-registered rule fires: A1 n_full=0 => no non-trivial placement exists

sealed_predictions.p_chance_basis: 3 numbers-valued primaries @1/9e6; 1 uuid primary ~0 (D8 binding figures)
sealed_predictions.n_accounting: n_agg=9600 pooled scored retrievals over the 4 certification primaries (2400/task); ~400/stratum pooled; D4 >=100/stratum floor cleared BY POOLING (per-task realized minima >=369 in S26/S27 verify); frozen n>=2048 floor met 4.7x
sealed_predictions.stratum_membership: a scored retrieval belongs to the stratum its realized distance clusters at (generator clusters at stratum points; tolerance drift essay+/-2, noise+/-6, needle+/-12)
sealed_predictions.d4_exclusion_rule: (task,stratum) realized count <100 => excluded from that task's evaluable-strata tally + flagged instrument_caution:low_n; <20/24 evaluable => that task INSTRUMENT_SUSPECT, reported, never forced

preregistered_gates.PRIMARY_certification: Per certified cell (A1, A4): |observed-predicted| <= T_agg=0.03 aggregate AND per-stratum |observed-predicted| <= 0.05 on >=20/24 strata. Boundary convention b=W inclusive (p1d G6/p1e G7 precedent).
preregistered_gates.certification_cell_designation: Verdict adjudicated on A1; A4 co-registered. A4-pass/A1-fail (or reverse) = PARTIAL CERTIFICATION, both stated, NEVER collapsed (D8 verbatim).
preregistered_gates.SECONDARY_kv_state: Arithmetic FROZEN PRE-DATA at L=8192/bf16: full layer 32.00 MiB; windowed layer W/1024*32 MiB. A1=112.00, A2=392.00, A3=252.00, A4=56.00, base=896.00. A1 beats A2 iff obs(A2)<0.5833333; beats A3 iff obs(A3)<0.3750000. Comparators=A2/A3 ONLY; A4 reported, not gated. REGISTERED PRE-DATA: A1 is arithmetically guaranteed to LOSE to A4 on recall-per-byte if both certify (f/W decreasing on this ladder) — instrument property, not law failure.
preregistered_gates.KILL_i_random_placement: NOT EVALUABLE — the comparator does not exist (A5 skipped). Must NEVER be reported as satisfied/passed (D8 verbatim).
preregistered_gates.KILL_ii_lm_loss: delta <= 0.10 NATS vs unconverted base (held-out FineWeb-Edu tail, seqlen 2048, measured post full registered budget; signature 1 verbatim). Scope = certified arm A1 ONLY; all other arms report descriptively. ALSO report A1 LM loss at seqlen 8192 (where windowing actually bites) — reporting only, non-gating (D8).
preregistered_gates.KILL_iii_reproduction: Battery on unconverted base == battery on no-op-initialized converted model, bit-identical logits, before scoring any converted arm (verify_noop_qwen3.py PASS on real weights; rerun per-arm at score time).
preregistered_gates.KILL_iv_no_efficacy_stopping: All arms run to the registered token budget.

stated_limitation.DOES: law placement vs folklore placement at matched W+budget (A1 vs A2/A3); law prediction vs observation at two independently trained windows (A1, A4).
stated_limitation.DOES_NOT: law-chosen vs arbitrary W — no deployment distribution to invert against; any such claim here would be unfalsifiable decoration. Inversion moves to teardown narrative w/ telemetry, labelled NON-CERTIFIED. P3 follow-on named: draw certification strata FROM the deployment distribution (provisioning input == measurement distribution) — the only falsifiable inversion design. (D8 verbatim)

training_recipe.budget_note: TOTAL across attention-transfer + LoRA stages (signature 2 verbatim); stage split 300M transfer / 200M LoRA (60/40, matching the S28 dry-run split used for the D5 end-to-end proof), identical across all arms and both targets
training_recipe.seqlen_note: REGISTERED (D8): must exceed max W or the mask is inert; corpus regenerated at block=2048 pre-spend (D8 blocking step 1)
training_recipe.corpus_mix: FineWeb-Edu slice re-tokenized Qwen3 (block 2048) + needle 0.10 + kv 0.10 (S05 data.py convention)
training_recipe.lora_optimizer_schedule: per D5-proven S28 configs, identical across arms

seeds.note: one seed per arm, pilot; second seed only on PASS (p1d->p1e precedent). A5 placement seed 2106 registered unused. Next free: 2107.

instrument.conversion_module: build/qwen3_windowed_decay_attention.py (B1; B2 no-op bit-identical + liveness + window-mask PASS on real weights)
instrument.d6_resume: checkpoint/resume round-trip exercised for BOTH trainers with real SIGKILL mid-run (S29 PASS)

battery.d3_step4: FIRES: both registered windows (1024, 512) are guard-banded grid points => sealed battery used AS-IS, no regeneration
battery.verify: S26/S27 verify_smoke_battery PASS, 0 failures; D7 train-pool collision reject armed

transfer_corpus.regenerated: 2026-08-06 ~04:38Z (D8 blocking step 1); same source slice/salts/path as block-1024 smoke corpus (bin bit-identical, sha verified); pools re-rolled at block 2048 under same salts

sweep_cost_accounting: Grid = SIX points {128,256,512,1024,2048,4096}; law path = 1x C_conv. Teardown MUST state full-sweep (5x C_conv) AND binary-search (2x C_conv) counterfactuals — never headline only the full-sweep figure (signature 3). Teardown must state the pilot ran 4 conversions of which 3 are controls a practitioner would not pay (D8 verbatim).
required_reporting: error decomposition r_in/r_out per cell (p1d r_out~0.02 alone eats ~0.017 of the 0.03 budget — cancelling errors must be visible)
per-stratum tally split in-window vs out-of-window
descriptive re-window ladder off A1 checkpoint at W {128,256,512,2048,4096}, 2400 retrievals, non-gating, CAP $15 — skip if quote exceeds
residual_risks: A1 may LOSE the secondary gate if folklore arms' full-attention layers retain recall — real result, registered pre-data, must not be reinterpreted after (D8 verbatim).
Pilot headline is narrower than charter: certifies ceiling AT A DECLARED W and placement-vs-folklore, NOT the law choosing W. Say so in the abstract (D8 verbatim).

spend.est_qwen_pilot: ~$19-44 base / <=~$130 worst-case on 2xL40S spot (signature 2); both targets <=~$270 at 2x contingency
spend.collection: evidence-gated collect+teardown (p1c pattern): sha256 + parseable result.json + non-empty scores + registered budgets verified BEFORE any DELETE
